description: verifyMailDns: Check that a mail domain's DNS records resolve; activates the domain for email when all records are found. Returns any still-missing records. Requires authentication.

domain.description: The mail-enabled domain to verify, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: verifyMailDns
